summary: Full E2E testing of Right Choice Services marketing site (first iteration). Backend: 8/8 pytest cases passed for /api/contact (POST/GET, validation), /api/newsletter (POST, idempotency, validation), and /api/. Frontend: all 14+ sections render, hero CTAs scroll to #contact/#services, header transitions to solid indigo on scroll, mobile menu opens/closes and auto-closes on link click, all desktop nav anchor links resolve (#home/#about/#services/#how-we-work/#faqs/#contact - all section IDs verified present), contact form submits with success toast + clears fields, newsletter subscribes (200) and is idempotent on duplicate, HTML5 invalid email validation blocks submit, FAQ accordion expands (data-state=open), 0 console errors, 0 broken images.

issues: Header has transparent background at top while body background is light grey; white nav link text (HOME/ABOUT/etc.) has low contrast against the light page background when not scrolled. Becomes readable once scrolled (solid indigo applied). Consider adding a subtle dark overlay/gradient at the top, or darkening nav text until scroll.

action_items: (Optional polish) Improve header nav text contrast at top-of-page state where the underlying background is light. Either keep header solid-translucent indigo from load, or darken nav link text until the page is scrolled past the hero.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes status_check, contact, newsletter in a single file (~140 lines) - acceptable for size now but split into routers/{contact,newsletter}.py as features grow.
Frontend uses axios with bare process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL - good. Toast error catch is a bare `catch {}` without logging; acceptable but consider console.error in dev.
Newsletter idempotency correctly returns existing record (200) - good. Consider returning 201 on first create vs 200 on existing for clearer semantics (not required by spec).
Contact GET endpoint is public - if expected to be admin-only later, add auth. Currently spec says public marketing site - OK.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes - excellent testability.
test_credentials: None - public marketing site, no auth required.
seed_data_creation: Tests create transient TEST_-prefixed contact messages and newsletter subscribers with random uuid emails. No cleanup endpoint exists (acceptable for MVP); volume is small.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py is the regression suite. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_api.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Public preview URL pulled from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All major data-testids: hero-section, hero-primary-cta, hero-secondary-cta, contact-form, contact-name-input, contact-email-input, contact-message-input, contact-submit-btn, newsletter-form, newsletter-email-input, newsletter-submit-btn, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-nav, desktop-nav, faq-item, site-header, site-footer. Section IDs: #home, #about, #services, #how-we-work, #faqs, #contact - all verified present.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found. Only a minor design-polish suggestion for header text contrast at the very top of the page (before scroll).
